note: How the gallery demonstrates each component. tool/gen_gallery.dart reads this together with ../../contracts/components.manifest.json and fails when the two disagree: every name the manifest claims must appear either in a demo's `shows` or in `undemoed` with a reason. A component the gallery has not reached needs no entry here (absence is not drift), but a claimed prop with no demo is recorded as undemoed and rendered as a gap -- it is never left silent.

undemoed.props.ariaLabel: An accessible name has no visual form. The sizes demo sets one on every icon-only button because the contract requires it there, but what is announced is asserted by the widget tests, not seen in a gallery.
undemoed.events.click: Every button in every demo carries a live onPressed -- that is the floor this gallery was built to meet. A callback has no appearance of its own to show.
undemoed.props.iconPosition: Not yet shown: the sizes demo places its icon in the default left position only.
undemoed.props.rounded: Not yet shown. The axis that matters is the theme-wide default -- KunThemeData.rounded squares or rounds every surface at once, as the web's config.rounded does -- and the gallery has no control for it; the per-widget override is the escape hatch, not the story.
